declaration.title: {{name}}'s Declaration of Independence:
declaration.body_1: I, {{name}}, will never use violence or harm anyone.
declaration.body_2: Because I, {{name}}, do not want to be a victim of violence, and because there is no authority, value, purpose, faith, money, or interest that justifies harming a person's life through violence or coercion.
declaration.body_3_start: Furthermore, I commit to creating, managing, and resolving disagreements on the
declaration.body_4: When the entire {{countries}} becomes a signatory to this Convention, I, {{name}}, will relinquish my weapons and the armed policemen acting on behalf of the {{countries}} State.
declaration.body_5: I will also give up the weapons of the {{countries}} Army when all of humanity becomes a signatory to this Convention.
declaration.body_6: I trust in the inherent goodness of humanity, and I hope that when all of humanity signs this Convention, violence, conflict, and coercion will cease to be forms of human communication.

maze.about_1lev1_body: 1💗1 is a separate website for managing agreements. It can gather and manage groups called fabrics around any dream or goal. You can negotiate agreements within a fabric and reach a joint decision. Agreements cover anything the fabric does — task allocation, resources, and earnings.
maze.about_fabric_body: One of the fabrics on 1💗1 is the Worldwide Consensus for Freedom. Its goal is to unite humanity's agreement on free conduct. Since fabrics on 1💗1 operate freely, agreeing to this is a prerequisite for registration.

hascama.headline: We all already agree on a world without violence. Let's prove it.
hascama.explain_1: In every language and culture people want the same thing: a life without violence and coercion. And yet there are wars.
hascama.explain_2: The silent majority agrees. It has simply never been counted.
hascama.explain_3: One page, one personal declaration — a journey of 9 billion steps. This one is yours.
